crossRefs.note: The king said, “Come and stand here.” He came, and stood still.

translations.web: The king said, “Come and stand here.” He came, and stood still.
translations.bsb: “Move aside,” said the king, “and stand here.” So he stepped aside.
translations.kjv: And the king said unto him, Turn aside, and stand here. And he turned aside, and stood still.
translations.asv: And the king said, Turn aside, and stand here. And he turned aside, and stood still.
